an8.73:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Nāṭike viharati Giñjakāvasathe.
an8.73:1.4: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an8.73:1.6: Maraṇasati bhikkhave bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānā.
an8.73:1.7: Bhāvetha no tumhe bhikkhave maraṇasatin ti. 3.
an8.73:2.1: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.73:2.3: ‘Yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatin' ti?
an8.73:2.5: "aho vatāhaṃ rattindivaṃ jīveyyaṃ, Bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā" ti:
an8.73:2.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatin' ti. 4.
an8.73:3.1: Aññataro pi kho bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.73:3.2: ‘aham pi kho bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatin' ti.
an8.73:3.3: ‘Yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatin' ti?
an8.73:3.5: "aho vatāhaṃ divasaṃ jīveyyaṃ, Bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā" ti:
an8.73:3.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatin' ti. 5.

an8.73:4.2: ‘aham pi kho bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatin' ti.

an8.73:6.2: ‘ahaṃ pi kho bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatin' ti.
an8.73:6.3: ‘Yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatin' ti?

an8.73:7.2: ‘aham pi kho bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatin' ti.
an8.73:7.3: ‘Yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatin' ti?
an8.73:7.5: "aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ cattāro pañca ālope saṃkhāditvā ajjhoharāmi, Bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā" ti:

an8.73:8.2: ‘aham pi kho bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatin' ti.

an8.73:8.5: "aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ ekaṃ ālopaṃ saṃkhāditvā ajjhoharāmi, Bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā" ti:
an8.73:8.6: evaṃkho ahaṃ bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatin' ti. 10.
an8.73:9.1: Aññataro pi kho bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.73:9.2: ‘aham pi kho bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatin' ti.
an8.73:9.3: ‘Yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatin' ti?
an8.73:9.5: "aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ assasitvā vā passasāmi passasitvā vā assasāmi, Bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā" ti:
an8.73:9.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatin' ti. 11.
an8.73:10.1: Evaṃ vutte Bhagavā te bhikkhū etad avoca:--
an8.73:10.2: Yvāyaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti
an8.73:10.3: ‘aho vatāhaṃ rattindivaṃ jīveyyaṃ, Bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā' ti.
an8.73:10.4: Yo pāyaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti
an8.73:10.5: ‘aho vatāhaṃ divasaṃ jīveyyaṃ, Bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā' ti.
an8.73:10.6: Yo pāyaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti
an8.73:10.7: ‘aho vatāhaṃ upaḍḍhadivasaṃ jīveyyaṃ, Bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā' ti.
an8.73:10.8: Yo pāyaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti
an8.73:10.9: ‘aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ ekaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjāmi, Bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā' ti.
an8.73:10.10: Yo pāyaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti
an8.73:10.11: ‘aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ upaḍḍhapiṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjāmi, Bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā' ti.
an8.73:10.12: Yo pāyaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti
an8.73:10.13: ‘aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ cattāro pañca ālope saṃkhāditvā ajjhoharāmi, Bhagayato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā' ti.
an8.73:10.14: Ime vuccanti bhikkhave bhikkhū pamattā viharanti, dandhaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāventi āsavānaṃ khayāya.
an8.73:11.1: Yo ca khvāyaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti
an8.73:11.2: ‘aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ ekaṃ ālopaṃ saṃkhāditvā ajjhoharāmi, Bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā' ti.
an8.73:11.3: Yo pāyaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti
an8.73:11.4: ‘aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ assasitvā vā passasāmi passasitvā vā assasāmi, Bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā' ti.
an8.73:11.5: Ime vuccanti bhikkhave bhikkhū appamattā viharanti, tikkhaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāventi āsavānaṃ khayāya.
an8.73:12.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ:--
an8.73:12.2: Appamattā viharissāma, tikkhaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāvessāma āsavānaṃ khayāyā ti. Evaṃ
